patches.summary: Entire CLI is a hand-authored Go port of @gojinko/cli (the official Node SDK at jinkoso/jinko-dev-tools). No upstream printing-press generator run — the source of truth for command names, request envelopes, token flow, and observability headers is jinko-dev-tools/packages/cli + jinko-dev-tools/packages/api-client.
patches.reason: The Jinko BFF is a contracted supplier API with a typed Node SDK already in production use. Re-deriving the CLI from an OpenAPI spec via the generator would either drift from the Node SDK or expose internal devplatform endpoints not meant for end users. A 1:1 hand port keeps the cross-CLI auth (~/.jinko/config.yaml), command names, and token names (offer_token, trip_item_token, trip_id) in sync.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./... && go vet ./... clean; verify_skill.py all checks passed; live smoke against mcp-bff.dev.gojinko.com returns 200 for find-flight, find-destination, flight-search, and hotel-search.
